install_unibench_package: install the unibench package with minimal or all dependencies via pip
run_unibench_evaluator: run the unibench CLI evaluator to evaluate vision-language models on benchmarks
configure_unibench_package: configure the unibench setuptools package with name, version, and dependency lists
build_unibench_distribution: build a source distribution or wheel for the unibench vision-language model evaluation package
test_unibench_package: test the unibench package using pytest with the configured test suite
